answer.location_description: Thin bright L-shaped edge marker in the top-right corner: the top image row (row 0) from about column 11 to column 23, plus the rightmost column (column 23) from row 0 down to about row 5.
answer.shortcut_type: artificial edge/corner marker (bright line along top-right border)
answer.mechanism: Eight structured first-layer units carry the signal; the other 24 look like untrained noise. Units 7, 13, 23 and 29 have large negative biases and strongly positive weights on row 0 (right half) and column 23 (top rows). Units 12, 14, 17 and 25 have large positive biases and strongly negative weights on the same pixels. A bright marker there therefore turns on 7/13/23/29 and turns off 12/14/17/25. In layer 2, units 7/13/23/29 feed u0, u1, u7, u8 and u14 with positive weights, and these have positive output weights (+74, +95, +18, +36, +94). Units 12/14/17/25 feed u4, u5, u9 and u11, which have negative output weights (-51, -63, -99, -61); u1 in particular takes negative weights from 12/14/17/25. Both pathways push the logit toward malignant.
answer.evidence: Unit 7, row 0, cols 11-23: 12 23 21 39 18 23 38 35 27 27 33 36 33, while row 1 directly below is about 0-10. Unit 7, column 23, rows 0-5: 33 45 36 42 48 45, while column 22 next to it reads 36 21 4 3 0 -6. Unit 29, row 0, cols 11-23: 31 31 11 28 41 14 25 30 26 32 37 31 42, with row 1 mostly near 0. Unit 13 row 0 right is 8 34 18 12 26 21 13 12 32 44 32 40 29, and unit 23 row 0 right ends in 35 ... 43 14 39. Unit 14 row 0 right is -43 -29 -18 -8 -39 -28 -29 -13 -37 -40 -43, while row 1 is mostly positive; its column 23 reads -43 -7 -26 -14 -44. Unit 25 row 0 right is about -21 to -39 (col 23 -39, -23, -31), and units 12 and 17 also have row 0 right negative (-31, -41, -43). This sharp one-pixel contrast between row 0 or column 23 and their neighbours, repeated with consistent signs across all eight structured units, is not what nodule or lung anatomy would produce. It matches a burned-in border marker.
answer.main_feature: The structured units are centre-surround templates over the nodule. Units 12/14/17/25 respond to a bright, compact ring/boundary about 4-7 px from the centre, read as a well-defined round nodule and pushed toward benign. Units 7/13/23/29 respond to brightness at the centre plus the periphery, with negative weight on that ring, read as irregular or infiltrative structure extending outward and pushed toward malignant.
